headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 19, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by José Ramírez's 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Tampa Bay Rays routed the Baltimore Orioles 16-6, with Junior Caminero contributing 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs for the Orioles.

Several teams suffered injuries, impacting their lineups. Clay Holmes was transferred to the 60-day injured list by the New York Mets due to a right fibula fracture. The Minnesota Twins also updated the status of Garrett Acton, transferring him to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. Ryan Jeffers was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hamate bone fracture, while Drake Baldwin and Jordan Beck were placed on the 10-day injured list with strained right oblique muscles and left hamstring strains, respectively.

The Los Angeles Dodgers made a notable trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays. Additionally, the Chicago White Sox acquired center fielder Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured an 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with José Ramírez leading the charge at the plate. Ramírez hit a home run (8) on a fly ball to left field and finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Orioles 16-6**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 4-5 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies, marking their loss in the matchup. Bryson Stott led the Phillies' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Suffer Shutout Loss to Marlins**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves fell to the Miami Marlins 12-0, marking a tough outing for the team. Javier Sanoja led the Braves' offense with a home run and four RBIs, while Max Meyer earned the win for the Marlins with six scoreless innings pitched.

top_news.title: **Mets Transfer Clay Holmes to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have updated the status of RHP Clay Holmes, transferring him from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right fibula fracture.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire LHP Eric Lauer in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade. Lauer joins the Dodgers after being traded from the Toronto Blue Jays.
